summaries.en: RenoDX is an open-source renovation engine for DirectX games, designed to let modders inject or customize HDR rendering without altering game binaries. Technically, it uses HLSL shaders to intercept and extend graphics pipelines, giving precise control over tone mapping, brightness, and color grading. This enables adding high-quality HDR to games that lack native support or fixing washed-out visuals. The framework simplifies building and sharing HDR mods, making advanced rendering tweaks accessible to a broader modding community. Typical uses include crafting custom HDR presets, adapting color spaces, and experimenting with post-processing for older or newer DirectX titles.

summaries.en: **summary_en (80 words):** This is a BERT-large model fine-tuned on CoNLL-2003 for named entity recognition (NER), solving the task of extracting names of people, organizations, and locations from text. Its technical value lies in the cased transformer architecture combined with a token-classification head, which preserves case cues that often matter for proper nouns. You can load it via Hugging Face pipelines for instant NER, or fine-tune it further on domain-specific documents to build custom extraction tools for news, legal, or biomedical corpora. **summary_zh (120–160字)：** 这是一个在CoNLL-2003语料上微调的BERT-large命名实体识别模型，专门用于从文本中识别人名、地名、机构名等实体。它采用带token分类头的Transformer结构，保留了大小写信息——这对专有名词的识别很关键，也是它的技术亮点。使用时，你可以通过Hugging Face的pipeline几行代码跑起来，或者基于它继续微调，适配法律、医疗等特定领域的文本抽取任务。想快速提取新闻或报告中的关键实体？直接用这个模型就是一个很稳的起点。

summaries.en: Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF is a 9-billion-parameter conversational language model released in GGUF format, designed to lower deployment barriers while retaining strong text-generation quality. The GGUF quantization reduces memory and compute requirements, enabling it to run on consumer CPUs and edge devices via llama.cpp or similar runtimes. Its MIT license and endpoint compatibility simplify integration into existing workflows. You can use it to quickly build local chatbots, offline assistants, or prototype novel conversational interfaces by loading the model file and experimenting with your own prompts.

summaries.en: Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF is an open-weight 9B conversational model quantized into GGUF format, enabling efficient local or edge deployment without relying on cloud APIs. Its technical highlight is the GGUF quantization scheme, which reduces memory and compute needs while preserving the model’s dialogue quality—making it easy to run on consumer hardware through llama.cpp or similar runtimes. You can directly download the files, load them with a GGUF-compatible tool, and integrate into chat apps, experiment with prompts, or fine-tune further for domain-specific assistants. This practical approach makes powerful language modeling more accessible for hobbyists and developers alike.
